author: devbig030
body: Implemented on feat/layered-support after rebase as 8a1416a (cleanup 9b60292): generic optional Scheduler userspace-control period/iteration event, real scx_layered usage sampling, live CPU reallocation, and real BPF_PROG_RUN refresh. Behavior is proven by enabled (3,1) vs disabled (2,2) and a refresh sabotage that leaves serialized (3,1) but BPF (2,2). Broader scheduler-owned growth policy is tracked separately as sim-juru9; NUMA remains outside scope.
